minecraft:written_book_content.author: Dr. I. Marsh
pages: {"text": "Observations from the far station.\n\nThe void beneath us is not empty. Lights move in it, slowly, as if looking. The shell-creatures guard the towers and ignore us entirely."}
{"text": "The wing-harness works. A crewman glided the length of the island and back. The Guild wants a hundred.\n\nI want to know what the draught carries back with it."}
{"text": "Each measure of draught we send home carries passengers. The clerks call them lodgers. They ride the cold back into the world and they stay."}
{"text": "We are not drawing power. We are being drawn on.\n\nI have written this to the Guild four times. I will not write it a fifth. I.M."}
